historical_reviews.v3_1: The test must distinguish repository readability from event-generation stress. More than 3000 records can cross capacity and overwrite the very baseline needed to explain all events, so count, rate, overflow behavior and record retention are part of the acceptance oracle rather than incidental setup.

original_test_intent: Verify SEL repository capacity, readability and complete event decoding after more than 3000 controlled events, with consistent evidence across IPMI, BMC Web and BIOS.
original_method: On an isolated owner-approved SUT, export and hash baseline SEL and system evidence, apply only a vendor-supported bounded event stimulus with a known manifest and capacity/overflow contract, capture complete pre/post SEL info and records plus same-target Web/BIOS views, and map every expected entry without clearing evidence.
manual_activity: The owner approves an isolated target, event generator, count/rate, overflow and recovery contract; an operator validates Web/BIOS views and owns the final interpretation and verdict.
required_inputs: SEL capacity, retention and overflow semantics
Expected event manifest and decode schema
Same-target BMC Web and BIOS capture path
Immutable evidence storage and recovery guidance
safety_requirements: Export and hash complete baseline before stimulus
Do not clear SEL or other logs by default
Monitor BMC health and free SEL capacity
Stop on instability or unexpected severity
Reject unknown, duplicate, stale or cross-target records
Do not automatically retry a partial stress run
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and approved stimulus contract
Collect baseline SEL info and complete records
Capture complete post-stimulus IPMI, Web and BIOS evidence
Map each event to the approved schema
Report capacity, overflow and retention results
engineer_actions: Review BMC health and retained evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The DUT SSH `sel list -v` command is not the stated ipmitool procedure, disables host-key verification, exposes a password and omits `sel info`, event creation and BMC Web/BIOS evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected BMC access for complete `ipmitool sel info` and record export before and after a separately approved bounded event generator; retain same-target BMC Web and BIOS evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 20/20-minute estimates, more-than-3000-event scope and all-event explanation criterion remain; log clearing is preserved as an explicit destructive source step but prohibited by default.

modernized_recommendation.status: APPROVAL-GATED BOUNDED SEL CAPACITY AND DECODE STRESS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an event ledger containing stimulus ID, expected type/severity, generation acknowledgement, SEL record ID/time, IPMI decode, Web/BIOS representation and retention/overflow result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a controlled generator, baseline preservation, capacity contract and record-level multi-surface correlation instead of an unsafe list-only SSH command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A SEL listing alone cannot prove 3000-event generation, overflow behavior, complete decoding or Web/BIOS parity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Crossing repository capacity may irreversibly overwrite older records; no automated recovery can recreate lost diagnostic evidence.

project_override_considerations: The Project must supply the supported event generator, event schema, capacity/overflow rules and recovery policy. Any later SEL clear is a separate destructive case with its own explicit approval and immutable export gate.
expected_evidence: Verified target, approval, SEL capacity/overflow contract and baseline hashes
Approved stimulus manifest, count/rate timeline and acknowledgements
Complete redacted pre/post SEL info and record exports
Same-target BMC Web and BIOS evidence
BMC health, retention/overflow result, no-unapproved-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require viewing and explaining SEL records after a large event load across IPMI, Web and BIOS. Missing generator and capacity semantics are critical prerequisites, not competing source scopes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is not globally blocked because a vendor generator, isolated target and repository contract can be requested. Execution is blocked until those inputs and explicit approval exist, or if baseline retention cannot be protected.

review_improvement: Makes the destructive capacity boundary and event-to-record oracle explicit, preventing an unsafe list command from masquerading as a complete 3000-event SEL stress and decode test.
independent_technical_reasoning: SEL repositories are finite and platform-specific. At 3000+ inserts, record IDs may wrap, old records may be overwritten or allocation may reject new entries; UI and BIOS can also paginate or normalize messages differently. Only a known stimulus manifest plus complete repository metadata and cross-surface record correlation can distinguish correct overflow behavior from lost or unexplained events.
